title: ADR-0048 status line: drop the "packages with no dependency relation keep §3.3" carve-out for doc (a bare doc read of a name two enabled packages hold refuses 409, ruling 6893582352)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUcj2x2Wr4UErwBi12

Filing gate: ② a governed-text follow-up a recorded ruling names. Filed by area S5 (E1b) for the domain:skills lane, as ruling 6893582352 on #33264 requires.

## 维护者速读

- 要做的：ADR-0048 的状态行里保留了一句"没有依赖关系的包仍按 §3.3（不指明包的读取返回第一个匹配）"。对文档（doc）类型，这句已被裁决 6893582352 推翻：两个启用的包有同名文档时，不指明包的读取返回 409 并列出各包。
- 改法：在状态行里把 doc 从这句保留中去掉，并引用该裁决和 PR #34036。
- 只改文字，不改代码。这是受管面（docs/adr/**），需要维护者批准。

## What is owed

`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` line 3 (Status) reads "Packages with no dependency relation keep §3.3 and §3.4 as written". Ruling 6893582352 (maintainer, 2026-11-15, option A) says: "The ADR-0048 status line drops its 'packages with no dependency keep the old sentence' carve-out for `doc`. That is a docs/adr/** status-line edit, carried by a domain:skills card."

Acceptance: the status line names `doc` as outside that carve-out (a bare doc read of a name two or more enabled packages hold answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder), citing ruling 6893582352 and the implementing PR #34036. No other sentence moves.

Prior rulings read: ruling 6893582352 (verbatim above); ADR-0146 D8 (already supersedes §3.3 in part); ADR-0150 D1 keeps `doc` in bucket 1 (addressing unchanged; this is not a re-bucketing).

Dedupe: searched "ADR-0048 status line doc": none.
